title: Longest Subarray with at Most K Distinct Elements
description: Given an array of integers nums and an integer k, find the length of the longest subarray containing at most k distinct elements.
exampleInput:
Example 1: nums = [...], k = 2
Example 2: nums = [...], k = 3
Example 3: nums = [...], k = 1

title: 4Sum – All Distinct Quadruplets with Given Sum
description:
Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, find all unique quadruplets (a, b, c, d) in the array such that a + b + c + d = target.
The solution set must not contain duplicate quadruplets.
The algorithm should be optimized for time and space; a naive brute-force is not acceptable.
exampleInput:
Example 1: nums = [1, 0, -1, 0, -2, 2], target = 0
Example 2: nums = [...], target = 8

title: Count Subarrays With Sum Divisible By K
description: Given an array of integers nums of length n and an integer k > 1, return the total number of contiguous subarrays for which the sum is divisible by k.
exampleInput:
Example 1: nums = [4,5,0,-2,-3,1], k = 5
Example 2: nums = [...], k = 3
